% Generated by scripts/p127_budget_specialists.py, training seeds 301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306, 307, 308, 309, 310 (10 seeds; intervals over training seeds and test instances); the comparison is not planned in the statistical protocol
% Gaps in %, seed s against seed s, hierarchical 95% intervals of p88, B = 20000. BspPol<R>: the policy minus the budget-sharing specialist (250 updates), over it (positive = the policy is slower); BspStd<R>: the policy minus the specialist (1000 updates), over it; BspShare<R>: the budget-sharing specialist minus the specialist, over the specialist (positive = longer schedules after 250 updates). Pool<F>: pooled over All (eight), Train (six) or Held (two) combinations.
% BspPol<R>Verdict: ahead = hierarchical 95% CI below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p-values (seed-level t, bootstrap; H1 the policy faster) below 0.05; behind = CI above zero and both Holm-adjusted p-values for H1 the policy slower (its own Holm family over the eight combinations) below 0.05; not distinguishable otherwise (p88.superiority_block, fresh draws per combination).
